name: Dashboard Achiri stats panel
goal: Add an Achiri stats panel to the operator dashboard. Shows today's message count, unique user count, and total waitlist size. Data read from workspace/achiri/daily-counts.json and workspace/achiri/waitlist.jsonl. Gives operator visibility into Achiri usage before and after the Apr 25 alpha launch.
rationale: Apr 25 Achiri alpha: operator needs to see usage at a glance (is anyone using it? how many messages today? waitlist growing?). Without a dashboard panel, operator must parse JSONL manually. Panel 16/17 on the dashboard roadmap.
swarm: NOT USED — 1 new parser file + 3 small edits (server.py, index.html, app.js). Direct write.

tasks.title: dashboard/parsers/achiri.py — Achiri stats parser
tasks.description: New file. parse_achiri_stats(base_dir: Path) -> dict. Reads workspace/achiri/daily-counts.json (structure: {date: {userId: count}}). Gets today's date (YYYY-MM-DD). today_messages = sum of all values for today's key. today_users = count of unique keys for today. Reads workspace/achiri/waitlist.jsonl (one JSON object per line, each has chatId). total_waitlist = count of entries. Returns { today_messages, today_users, total_waitlist, today_date }. Returns zeros if files don't exist.

tasks.title: dashboard/server.py — /api/achiri/stats route
tasks.description: Add import of parse_achiri_stats from dashboard.parsers.achiri. Add route: @app.get('/api/achiri/stats') async def achiri_stats(): stats = parse_achiri_stats(BASE_DIR); return JSONResponse(stats). BASE_DIR is the project root (Path(__file__).parent.parent or however it's currently defined). Add after the experiments routes.

tasks.description: Add async function renderAchiriPanel(). Fetches /api/achiri/stats. Renders: today_messages (Today Messages), today_users (Today Users), total_waitlist (Waitlist), today_date. Use same stats-row/stat-block pattern as existing panels. Displays 'Alpha launch Apr 25' note. Add renderAchiriPanel() call in the refreshAll() function alongside other panel renders.

tasks.title: scripts/achiri/validate-sprint-139.ts — validation script
tasks.description: Check: (1) dashboard/parsers/achiri.py exists; (2) achiri.py contains parse_achiri_stats; (3) achiri.py reads daily-counts.json; (4) server.py imports parse_achiri_stats; (5) server.py has /api/achiri/stats route; (6) index.html has achiri-body element; (7) app.js has renderAchiriPanel function; (8) app.js calls renderAchiriPanel in refreshAll. 8 checks, exit 0 on all pass.
